review.notes: Fence inventory is balanced (one 3-backtick pair, the printed result-format block). Full window diff of extracted PDF text for all 23 pages against the OCR Markdown; every unmatched window was inspected and classified. All 9 table captions, all 7 figure captions, the references (pages 18-20), the Appendix E author lists and the appendix tables are present in the OCR; remaining unmatched windows are LaTeX-equivalent math, figure-internal axis text, PDF-side URL line breaks and soft hyphenation that the OCR joined correctly. Pages 3, 5, 12, 14, 21, 23 were additionally rendered and visually verified (footnote bodies, the printed JSON example, Table 8 cells, the author name). All five page-bottom footnote bodies were dropped by OCR while the $^{N}$ markers survive; they are restored after the paragraphs carrying the markers. The source itself prints 'cite_name' and 'DeepSeek-V32-Exp' (verified at 300 dpi), so those OCR strings match the print and were left unchanged. Punctuation spacing after inline math is handled by the shared OCR normalizer.

unresolved.evidence: 'An Example of Synthesized Task: Trip Planning', 'Submit Result Format' and 'Tool Set for Trip Planning' are transcribed as section headings. The render shows them as titles of printed prompt boxes (dark banner for the tool-set table), i.e. real page text rather than figure-internal labels; the heading level was kept because the box bodies are transcribed inline as body text and the shared structure checker treats printed prompt-box titles as legitimate.

Equations (1)-(12) and the appendix tensor diagram are extracted by PyMuPDF as bold-italic Unicode runs; OCR renders LaTeX-equivalent math, so the window diff cannot certify spacing inside every equation. Digit-level greps found no spaced digits and no count mismatches for the printed constants (10^-3, 7.3x10^-6, 2048, 15000, 943.7B, 2.1B, 128K, 1,800, 85,000), but per-token equation proofing was not done.
